reading.title: A Day at the Farm and the Zoo
reading.text: Last Sunday our class visited a farm and a zoo. At the farm we saw cows, sheep, pigs, goats and chickens. The farmer told us that cows give milk and sheep give wool. The chickens give eggs every morning. We fed the goats and they were very hungry! In the afternoon we went to the zoo. We saw an elephant with a long nose, a giraffe with a very long neck, and a big lion. The monkeys were funny. They jumped from tree to tree. The snake frightened some girls. My favourite animal was the tiger. It was beautiful.

reading.title: A Journey to Paris
reading.text: Last month Hasan travelled to Paris. He bought a return ticket and checked in at the airport two hours before the flight. He gave his boarding card to the flight attendant and got on the plane. The plane took off at ten o'clock and landed in Paris at half past one. After landing, Hasan went through customs. Nobody checked his passport for a long time. Then he took a taxi to his hotel. The next day he used the underground and a map to see the city. He also took a bus tour. The journey was long, but he enjoyed every minute.

reading.title: Christmas in the UK
reading.text: Christmas is the biggest festival in the UK. It is on the twenty fifth of December. Weeks before, families decorate a Christmas tree and send Christmas cards to their friends. On Christmas morning, children open their presents. The family spends the day together and eats a big dinner. A traditional Christmas dinner has roast turkey, potatoes and vegetables. The day after Christmas is a bank holiday called Boxing Day. A week later, on New Year's Eve, people sing and dance and watch fireworks. Many families in the UK also enjoy fish and chips, but this is not a Christmas dish.

reading.title: A Burglary at School
reading.text: Last night there was a burglary at our school. The burglar broke into the building through a window and took four computers from the office. In the morning the head teacher called the police. The police came and looked at the broken window. They asked the neighbours if they saw anything. One neighbour said he saw a man with a big bag near the school at midnight. The next day the police arrested a young man in a shop. He was trying to sell the computers. The man must go to court next week. If he is guilty, he will have to pay a fine or go to prison.

reading.title: Media in My Family
reading.text: My family uses the media every day. My father reads the newspaper in the morning and watches the news on TV at six o'clock. My mother likes soap operas and talk shows. My brother watches reality TV, but I prefer nature programmes and documentaries. My sister is a journalist and writes articles for a magazine. Sometimes she interviews famous people. There are many adverts on TV and in magazines, but we do not always trust them. In the evening we can all watch TV together. We often argue about the channel! Then my father says, "Let's watch the news."
